incident-bot: ALERT: increased fallback churn detected for smart-routing cluster eu-west-1 at 06:14 UTC — 5xx spikes + fallback loop signature. paging mike (oncall).

mike (oncall): on it. seeing errors on the dashboard. spike started ~06:12.

mike (oncall): @tina can you grab SRE? looks like policy evaluation returning deprecated 'route_preference' default -> causing ambiguous routing.

tina (sre): joining. I can see continuous failover logs: `policy-evaluator: deprecated field route_preference used, defaulting to legacy-fallback` repeated across nodes. fallback toggles every 30s.

alex (eng-ml): oh no — we rolled the schema migration last night to relax validation for legacy fields. Did that change flip the default for unspecified routes?

lena (product): yes, we merged the schema mapping that allows missing `preferred_variant` to inherit `route_preference` legacy value. That was to aid old configs, but perhaps we accidentally enabled a permissive default.

sean (support): customer impact: three paying customers in EU seeing elevated latencies and 10-20% increased error traces. One customer reported wrong model variant being served for their reranker requests -> degrade in quality.

mike (oncall): steps: 1) stop the cascading failovers 2) set a stable routing default 3) notify impacted customers and start mitigation.

tina (sre): quick mitigation idea: toggle policy-evaluator to strict mode so deprecated fields are ignored. Is there a runtime flag?

alex (eng-ml): yes, there's a runtime flag `--ignore-legacy-routing` that we can flip per region. We should avoid full deploy if possible.

mike (oncall): @deploy-bot can we flip env var on eu-west-1 pod pool?

deploy-bot: command accepted: `infra patch runtime-cluster eu-west-1 --env "IGNORE_LEGACY_ROUTING=true"`. rolling patch across 12 pods. ETA ~5m.

tina (sre): logs during patch: `patching node r-3a: success`, `r-3b: success`, `r-4a: success`... fallbacks quieting on patched nodes.

alex (eng-ml): good. while patch rolls, let's also lock model variants for affected customers to stable-v2 so even if routing rules mis-evaluate they still hit v2. I can push a temporary override via the customer routing table.

mike (oncall): do it. which customers? sean, can you list the impacted tenants?

sean (support): impacted_tenants: ["finmate", "shoply", "eduhelm"]. I'll open support tickets and label them P1-impacting-generation.

alex (eng-ml): pushing overrides: `routectl set-override finmate --model stable-v2 --scope tenant --expires 2026-03-15T08:00:00Z`

deploy-bot: override applied for finmate. similar commands for shoply and eduhelm queued.

lena (product): agree with communication plan: tell customers we identified routing regression after config schema migration, temporary mitigations in place, ETA for full remediation 2-4 hours. I'll craft an incident banner.

mike (oncall): patch finished across eu-west-1. monitoring. fallbacks decreased 95% and 5xx rate trending down.

tina (sre): confirmed. fallback churn reduced to noise. but we still have nodes that didn't pick up the env due to older sidecars — I see 2 pods stuck.

alex (eng-ml): for those two, we should force-restart sidecar to pick up new env: `kubectl rollout restart ds/policy-evaluator -n redwood-eu --pod r-9c`. I'll run it on the two.

mike (oncall): go for it.

alex (eng-ml): restarted. sidecars reconnected. metrics now stable across region.

incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handover ping at 07:00 UTC to next oncall.

mike (oncall): handing off to tina at 07:00 UTC. I'm staying available for customer sync if needed.

tina (sre): I'll own the postmortem and remediation. immediate next steps: 1) revert the schema mapping that uses `route_preference` as implicit default 2) add validation to reject configs with deprecated fields unless explicitly toggled 3) add telemetry alert for deprecated-field-triggered fallbacks.

lena (product): agree. also need to coordinate with config migration owners — we must not silently map legacy fields to behavior-changing defaults.

alex (eng-ml): technical plan: revert: create PR to remove permissive mapping and re-run canary tests. Add guard in policy-evaluator: if deprecated field present emit metric `deprecated_field_used` for 30 days.

tina (sre): I'll create emergency runbook entry for this class of incident: detection pattern, immediate flags to flip, and the override command for tenant locking.

sean (support): customer comms sent to finmate & shoply (initial notification). eduhelm notified as well. copying on resolution steps and mitigation notes.

mike (oncall): status update for now: mitigated, fallbacks suppressed, customers under overrides, pod restarts completed. moving to monitoring and root-cause analysis.

lena (product): tagging this severity: sev2 given customer impact and partial degradation. Will schedule postmortem with eng-ml + infra + product tomorrow.

alex (eng-ml): small note: we should also add a non-breaking test to our CI that simulates missing `preferred_variant` with different schema behaviors to catch future regressions.

tina (sre): acknowledged. I'll attach logs & queries to the postmortem. Query used to detect: `sum by(cluster) (increase(policy_evaluator.fallback_count[5m])) > 10` — we should make that a persistent alert.

mike (oncall): final note before handoff: if any oncall sees fallback_count spike > 5/min in eu-west-1, escalate to pg.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem owner: tina (sre).

sean (support): closing slack loop, will follow up in support tickets. :white_check_mark:

alex (eng-ml): Thanks everyone. will open PR with revert and tests now.

mike (oncall): handing over. I'm available by DM.

tina (sre): taking over; will update thread with timeline + postmortem link when ready.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (will reopen automatically if fallback churn resumes).
